0|4e0effd9007ea0be31f7488611eb3824b4541554|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"igb: Make DMA faster when CPU is active on the PCIe link
Intel I210 on some Intel Alder Lake platforms can only achieve ~750Mbps
Tx speed via iperf. The RR2DCDELAY shows around 0x2xxx DMA delay
will be significantly lower when 1) ASPM is disabled or 2) SoC package
c-state stays above PC3. When the RR2DCDELAY is around 0x1xxx the Tx
speed can reach to ~950Mbps.
According to the I210 datasheet ""8.26.1 PCIe Misc. Register - PCIEMISC""
DMA Idle Indication"" doesn't seem to tie to DMA coalesce anymore
set it to 1b for ""DMA is considered idle when there is no Rx or Tx AND
when there are no TLPs indicating that CPU is active detected on the
PCIe link (such as the host executes CSR or Configuration register read
or write operation)"" and performing Tx should also fall under ""active
CPU on PCIe link"" case.
In addition to that

column1: code to separate function."") seems to wrongly changed from enabling
E1000_PCIEMISC_LX_DECISION to disabling it
